run_subprocess: run a subprocess command and capture its stdout and stderr output
set_env_var: set or unset an environment variable to a given value in the test environment
get_test_executable_path: get the absolute path of a test binary by name and verify it exists
get_exit_status: extract the exit status code from the result of os.system on Unix or Windows
get_temp_dir: get or create a temporary directory for storing test output files
